fullPassage: That bodily signals such as a racing heartbeat are interpreted as an emotion like fear or anxiety may be a mistake. In reality, physiological signals may actually dictate our emotional experiences rather than reflect them. This idea is centered around an overlooked internal sense called interoception, which is the awareness of bodily sensations including breathing, heartbeat, and muscle tension that enables us to monitor our physiological state and respond to it accordingly. Although it is difficult to scientifically prove how interoception works, studies are making some headway. In one experiment in which participants were shown images of fearful and neutral faces during different phases of their heart cycle, it was found that they recognized the fearful faces more easily and saw them as more alarming when their hearts were contracting than when they were relaxed. Also, their amygdalas (the brain area associated with processing emotional responses) showed greater activity during heart contractions. This suggests that the body speaks first.

In reality, physiological signals may actually dictate our emotional experiences rather than reflect them. This idea is centered around an overlooked internal sense called interoception, which is the awareness of bodily sensations including breathing, heartbeat, and muscle tension that enables us to monitor our physiological state and respond to it accordingly. Although it is difficult to scientifically prove how interoception works, studies are making some headway. In one experiment in which participants were shown images of fearful and neutral faces during different phases of their heart cycle, it was found that they recognized the fearful faces more easily and saw them as more alarming when their hearts were contracting than when they were relaxed. Also, their amygdalas (the brain area associated with processing emotional responses) showed greater activity during heart contractions. This suggests that the body speaks first.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.analysis:
① 일치 — the brain area associated with processing emotional responses
② 일치 — enables us to monitor our physiological state and respond to it accordingly
③ 일치 — participants were shown images of fearful and neutral faces
④ 불일치 — 원문은 'may actually dictate ... rather than reflect them'으로 좌우한다고 했는데, 진술은 '좌우하지 못하고 반영만 한다'로 정반대로 뒤집음 ←정답
det.tip: '좌우한다(dictate)'를 '반영만 한다(only reflect)'로 뒤집는 정반대 오답 패턴에 유의

ch: 편도체는 감정 반응을 처리하는 것과 관련된 뇌 영역이다.
interoception은 우리가 생리적 상태를 관찰하고 그에 맞게 반응하도록 해 준다.
실험에서 참가자들은 무서운 얼굴과 무표정한 얼굴의 이미지를 보았다.
이 글은 생리적 신호가 감정을 좌우하지 못하고 오직 반영하기만 한다고 본다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① responding → respond (helps us 뒤에서 keep과 병렬을 이루는 동사원형이어야 함)
det.analysis:

② ✅ 적절 — 주어 participants(복수)에 맞는 수동태 were shown
③ ✅ 적절 — 주어 their hearts(복수)에 맞는 과거진행 were contracting

det.korean: '그에 맞게 반응하다'는 동사 respond + to it(그것에) + accordingly(그에 맞게) 순서로 배열함
